attributes.board_name: Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation (IDFPR)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs by approved sponsors: NASW, ASWB (ACE) or affiliates, AAMFT, hospital employers, approved PC/MFT/clinical psychologist CE sponsors, accredited colleges/universities/state agencies, IDFPR-licensed SW CE sponsors (159-); college courses (1 semester hr = 15 CE hrs); teaching; publications/presentations
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE not required for the first renewal of a license.
rules.audit_note: Licensee answers a YES/NO CE question at renewal; proof only on random audit, restoration or discipline. Keep proof of CE.
rules.alternatives: One-time CE waiver may be requested with the renewal (before expiry) for full-time military service, incapacitating illness or similar extenuating circumstances.

topics.who: Alzheimer's disease and other dementias; once every 3 renewal periods
LCSW only, at the second renewal: clinical supervision training

rules.notes: CE must be completed in the 24 months before the expiration date printed on the license. Statutory expiry date not confirmed (ilga.gov admin code unreachable). Live remote or pre-recorded courses from approved sponsors count.
rules.legal_basis: 68 Ill. Adm. Code 1470.95 and 68 Ill. Adm. Code 1130 Subpart E
